title: [Request] Allow file uploads to set to context instead of rag
body:
### 🥰 Feature Description

When i upload a file it automatically starts chunking/embedding it, i want to be able to set to use the llm's context instead of embedding it, like in OpenWebUI where i have ethe "Bypass Embedding and Retrieval" option.

### 🧐 Proposed Solution

i think one input field is enough for this request

### 📝 Additional Information

_No response_
